Assessment Test IV

1. Carbon attains neon configuration by shar-
ing four electrons with other atoms. Hence, it
exhibits tetravalency.

Hence, the correct option is (a).

2. $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$ has a higher boiling point than HF due to
greater number of hydrogen bonds formed in
case of water, even though HF has a stronger
hydrogen bond.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

3. Z = 8; oxygen
Z = 17; chlorine
Z = 9; fluorine
Z = 7; nitrogen

The ease of formation of anion depends upon
the electron affinity value of non-metals. Elec-
tron affinity increases from left to right in a
period and decreases from top to bottom in a
group. Thus, the correct order is $\mathrm{Cl} > \mathrm{F} > \mathrm{O} > \mathrm{N}$.
Therefore, the required order is CDAB.
Hence, the correct option is (c).

4. The strength of the ionic bond is inversely
proportional to the size of the anion, provided
the cation is the same. The correct decreasing
order of strength ionic compounds should be
DBEAC.
Hence, the correct option is (a).

5. (i) $\rightarrow$ (C)
(ii) $\rightarrow$ (D)
(iii) $\rightarrow$ (A)
(iv) $\rightarrow$ (B)
(v) $\rightarrow$ (E)
Hence, the correct option is (d).

6. M + acid → metal salt + H$_2$
Mg + O$_2$ → MgO
Mg + N$_2$ → Mg$_3$N$_2$
Fe + S → FeS

All these reactions are redox reactions.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

7. In $\mathrm{M}_2\mathrm{X}_3$, metal has +3 charge and non-metal has
–2 charge. Therefore, the electrovalencies of
metal and non-metal are 3 and 2, respectively.
Hence, the correct option is (c).

8. The electronic configuration of metal could be
2, 8, 1. It can lose an electron to get the configu-
ration of neon. The electronic configuration of
a non-metal could be 2, 5 as it can gain three
electrons to get the configuration of neon.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

10. Z = 16 corresponds to sulphur and Z = 8 corre-
sponds to oxygen. Sulphur and oxygen belong
to VI group and form a covalent compound.
Hence, the correct option is (a).

11. In iron, the penultimate shell electrons can also
participate in metallic bonding. As more num-
ber of electrons are involved in metallic bond-
ing, the metallic bond becomes strong. This
imparts greater hardness to iron.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

12. Hydrogen bonding is responsible for relatively
high boiling point of water and dissolution of
glucose in water. Due to the presence of hydro-
gen bonding, water exists as associated liquids.
Conduction of electricity does not depend on
hydrogen bonding. It depends on the availabil-
ity of free electrons or ions as charge carriers.
Hence, the correct option is (d).
